Both refinements verified. Refresh **http://maker:4001**.

**Flow 11 (refined) — bulk actions.**
1. Tick two bookmarks, then **run a search or switch views** — the selection **clears automatically**, so you can never act on something that's now hidden. "Select all shown" only ever covers the search/view active at the moment you use it.
2. Tick a couple, choose **Remove tag…** — instead of typing, you now see **chips of the tags actually present** on the selected bookmarks. Click one (e.g. `#travel`) to remove it. If only some of the selected bookmarks carry that tag, it's removed from those and the rest are untouched (I verified removing `#travel` from a pair left the other bookmark's `#css` intact).

Both your rules hold: **actions target exactly the ticked items** (including ones scrolled off), but the selection is **reset whenever the shown set changes**. If that's right, bulk actions are settled and I'll move to **saved searches/filters** next.
